source_title: European Parliament New European Agenda for Culture implementation report
unit_or_scope: cultural relations and diplomacy across EU and partner contexts
direct_observation: Cultural relations are described as reciprocal non-coercive interaction while cultural diplomacy is more state-led and can be instrumentalised
missing_stage: reciprocal power local benefit remedy and later geopolitical behavior
evidence_status: high for distinction; medium for outcomes
next_test: code one exchange for agenda power and participant response

source_title: UNESCO Participatory and integrated approaches in cultural governance
direct_observation: Cultural governance frequently connects foreign affairs economy/business and education; participatory governance and civil society are emphasized
missing_stage: local cultural rights benefit and policy durability
evidence_status: high for architecture; medium for effects
next_test: match one programme budget across ministries and civil-society decisions

source_title: UN Peacebuilding community-engagement guidelines and Niger example
unit_or_scope: conflict-affected communities including Diffa and Tillabéri
direct_observation: Community-specific analysis local civil-society mapping and locally identified cultural festivals support reintegration and social cohesion work
missing_stage: continued local control changed relationships safety and recurrence
evidence_status: high for process; medium for outcomes
next_test: follow peace committee and participant outcomes after event

source_title: Council of Europe Intercultural Cities interaction checklist
unit_or_scope: intercultural city policy and everyday encounters
direct_observation: Meaningful interaction is more likely under equal status common objectives and cooperation; housing education sport commerce and culture shape contact
missing_stage: prejudice change resource equality conflict remedy and belonging
evidence_status: high for framework; medium for measured effects
next_test: compare participant status and repeated cross-group contact

source_title: UNESCO Culture for Peace independent expert group report
direct_observation: Local governments communities and civil society are identified as frontline actors; locally led cultural peacebuilding memory work and ethical digital infrastructure are recommended
missing_stage: named programme peace safety cultural-rights remedy and policy change
evidence_status: medium for principles; low for causal closure
next_test: build a named programme ledger with local decision and post-program behavior
